note: Graphics Overworld/custom_gfx.asm DMAs at runtime, for yaze's editor canvas and z3ed overworld-render. Numbers are decimal: parent_map 48 = $30, base 8192 = VRAM word $2000, 11264 = $2C00, 20480 = $5000. Keep parent_map equal to the CMP.b in CheckForChangeGraphicsNormalLoadBoat (the area's parent ID in $8A).

areas.note: D7 Dragon Ship. boat.bin replaces BG sheet slots 3-6 (characters $0C0-$1BF); boat2.bin replaces OBJ sheets 4-7 (yaze characters $300-$3FF).
